labelPolicy: Evocative names are optional Metheus editorial suggestions, not defaults or required stages. Always retain the canonical phase, layer, time window, source, method, and uncertainty. A person must choose whether to use, revise, or hide a suggestion; annotation nameSource records the name's origin. A name is never a biological inference.

phases.description: A fixed symbolic reference calculated from birth inputs within a named Human Design lineage.
phases.basisGuidance: Derived chart calculation; preserve source lineage, calculation method and version, and birth-input provenance.
constraints: Not a measured trait or developmental verdict.
Do not expose exact birth inputs through the display label.

phases.description: A symbolic transit period leading toward a calculated contact with a chart feature.
phases.basisGuidance: Derived transit interval with named ephemeris, calculation method, version, and contact rule.
constraints: Do not imply a destined event or physiological effect.
Retain the named system's canonical terminology.

phases.description: The exact or closest calculated contact in a named transit sequence.
phases.basisGuidance: Derived point or interval; preserve calculation precision, source, and version.
constraints: Astronomical position and symbolic meaning are distinct claims.
Do not present as a bodily event.

phases.description: A symbolic prompt for a transit moving beyond its exact contact.
phases.basisGuidance: Derived transit interval, with the contact and separation rule stated.
constraints: Does not establish that a life event occurred.
Do not imply biological causation.

phases.description: A symbolic review prompt associated with a calculated apparent-direction station.
phases.basisGuidance: Derived astronomical event with station calculation method and time precision.
constraints: Apparent direction change is not reversal of the planet's physical orbit.
Do not predict that someone will revisit an event.

phases.description: A later calculated contact in an explicitly named transit sequence.
phases.basisGuidance: Derived contact linked to the sequence and prior crossing identifiers.
constraints: Repetition is not proof of a lesson or outcome.
Name the system and calculation version.

phases.description: A symbolic reading of calculated planetary positions at a named aspect or transit.
phases.basisGuidance: Derived positions and aspect rule; preserve ephemeris and calculation version.
constraints: Keep calculation separate from tradition-attributed interpretation.
Do not imply biological causation.

phases.description: A calculated return to a defined chart position within a named astrological system.
phases.basisGuidance: Derived return calculation with body, reference position, method, and version.
constraints: Do not assign a universal age-based meaning.
Do not present as a physiological cycle.

phases.description: A repeatable cycle whose period and phase convention are defined by the named symbolic system.
phases.basisGuidance: Derived from source-defined start, period, and phase convention.
constraints: Do not imply physiological periodicity.
Retain source-defined canonical terms.

phases.description: A first reported menstrual bleeding milestone, if the person chooses to name it.
phases.basisGuidance: Person report or appropriately sourced caregiver report; record date precision and reporter.
constraints: Not a measure of maturity, fertility, or readiness.
Collect only when useful and wanted.

phases.description: A reported bleeding event or interval.
phases.basisGuidance: Reported or observed event with date/time precision and source.
constraints: Bleeding alone does not establish cycle phase, ovulation, hormone level, or cause.
Do not presume regular cycles or that menstruation applies.

phases.description: The recorded interval of bleeding as reported by the person.
phases.basisGuidance: Reported interval; retain uncertain start and end dates as uncertain.
constraints: Does not claim a particular endocrine state or mood.
Do not infer unrecorded days.

phases.description: A method-qualified follicular-phase estimate or assessment.
phases.basisGuidance: State the method, inputs, version, confidence, and whether this is an estimate or clinical assessment.
constraints: Calendar day alone does not establish hormone state.
Do not infer energy, mood, or estrogen level.

phases.description: An optional later-follicular sublabel within a method-supported phase estimate.
phases.basisGuidance: Method-qualified estimate or assessment with uncertainty.
constraints: Not a claim of rising energy, estrogen, or readiness without separate evidence.
Do not treat as a universal subphase.

phases.description: A method-supported estimate or assessment of an ovulatory window.
phases.basisGuidance: Name the method and evidence basis, including whether it is retrospective or prospective.
constraints: Does not establish fertility certainty or predict conception.
Do not infer from a calendar alone.

phases.description: A method-qualified luteal-phase estimate or assessment.
phases.basisGuidance: State method, inputs, version, and confidence; distinguish estimate from hormone assay.
constraints: Do not infer progesterone or mood from dates, temperature, or HRV alone.
Do not assume symptoms.

phases.description: An optional method-supported late-luteal context.
phases.basisGuidance: Method-qualified estimate with uncertainty and explicit phase convention.
constraints: Does not predict fatigue, irritability, or other symptoms.
Symptoms remain individually reported observations.

phases.description: A person-selected label for a self-reported symptom window.
phases.basisGuidance: Person report with time window and symptom source.
constraints: Not a diagnosis.
Do not infer from a cycle calendar.

phases.description: A private, person-chosen label for a conception attempt or fertility-care context.
phases.basisGuidance: Person-reported event or process; retain only what the person chose to record.
constraints: Do not infer conception, pregnancy, fertility status, or another person's intent.
Treat as sensitive reproductive information.

phases.description: A user-selected reflection label for a reported or clinically documented pregnancy context.
phases.basisGuidance: Person report or clinical record with source; gestational age only if supplied or clinically dated.
constraints: Not a description of fetal health, development, or outcome.
Do not assume pregnancy applies.

phases.description: A dated birth event as recorded by the person or authorized caregiver.
phases.basisGuidance: Reported or clinical event with reporter and date precision.
constraints: Does not predict emotional or physical experience.
Do not assume a particular family structure.

phases.description: A flexible context for changes in recovery, routines, relationships, and care after birth.
phases.basisGuidance: Person-defined or clinically documented window; duration may remain open or unspecified.
constraints: May overlap with lactation, recovery, sleep change, and other contexts.
No fixed duration, emotional course, or outcome is assumed.

phases.description: A person-defined early postpartum context.
phases.basisGuidance: Person-defined interval; do not silently impose a standard clock.
constraints: Not a universal fourth-trimester deadline.
Recovery, feeding, sleep, mood, and support can change at different rates.

phases.description: A flexible label for continuing adjustment, care, and changed routines.
phases.basisGuidance: Person-reported or assessed context with dates only as specifically known.
constraints: Does not imply recovery is complete or linear.
Does not assume the same experience for every family.

phases.description: A descriptive label for a reported feeding or lactation context.
phases.basisGuidance: Person or caregiver report; identify reporter and event source.
constraints: Does not assume lactation, feeding method, or caregiver identity.
Do not apply adult meal or fasting models to infant feeds.

phases.description: A variable menopause-transition context described by the person or clinician.
phases.basisGuidance: Self-report or clinical assessment with source and applicable terminology.
constraints: Do not infer from age alone or one hormone result.
Experiences and duration vary.

phases.description: A retrospective menopause milestone recorded under the relevant clinical convention.
phases.basisGuidance: Record the convention, source, and retrospective basis.
constraints: Not a single hormone state.
The poetic name never replaces the canonical milestone.

phases.description: A flexible context after the menopause milestone.
phases.basisGuidance: Person-reported or clinically assessed context with source.
constraints: Does not promise symptoms stop.
Does not imply uniform physiology.

phases.description: A pregnancy-period context, if relevant and authorized.
phases.basisGuidance: Caregiver or clinical context only; do not create an inferred psychological subject record for a fetus.
constraints: Not a fetal psychological assessment.
Use only when relevant to the person's stated purpose.

phases.description: A context around birth and early adaptation, with concrete observations kept separate.
phases.basisGuidance: Caregiver report, direct measurement, or clinical record must be identified separately.
constraints: Not an infant wellbeing assessment.
Do not infer internal state from a label or schedule.

phases.description: A flexible context for early interaction, sensory experience, sleep, and feeding observations.
phases.basisGuidance: Age basis and caregiver/source must be visible; observations are dated independently.
constraints: Do not infer internal state from routine logs.
Do not score development from this label.

phases.description: A reflection label for interaction and exploration when these are actually observed.
phases.basisGuidance: Use dated observations and source; age bands are contextual only.
constraints: No skill is presumed from age or label.
Do not use as a screening or prediction.

phases.description: A flexible context for observed changes in communication, movement, play, and autonomy.
phases.basisGuidance: Child and caregiver context with observations sourced and dated.
constraints: Avoid milestone deadlines and comparisons.
Preserve the child's growing voice and control.

phases.description: A context for evolving interests, relationships, and learning environments.
phases.basisGuidance: Use the learner's and caregiver's own context; observations remain separately sourced.
constraints: Not a fixed ability profile.
Do not infer a learning style from symbolic design.

phases.description: A broad, person-defined transition context.
phases.basisGuidance: Person-defined context; do not infer timing or identity from age alone.
constraints: Avoid assumptions about puberty timing, identity, emotional pattern, or readiness.
Do not predict developmental outcome.

phases.description: An optional life-course label for ongoing change and continuity.
phases.basisGuidance: Person-defined context, not a developmental score.
constraints: Do not imply completion, destiny, or fixed ability.

phases.description: An optional life-course label for change and continuity in later life.
phases.basisGuidance: Person-defined context with observations separately sourced.
constraints: Do not frame later life as decline or uniform experience.

phases.description: A name for an observed or estimated sleep-wake interval.
phases.basisGuidance: Retain timestamps, time zone, source, method, coverage, and uncertainty.
constraints: Clock time is not biological circadian phase.
A schedule is not proof of sleep quality or adequacy.

phases.description: A person-defined or sensor-observed context around waking and the beginning of a day.
phases.basisGuidance: Record local time, timezone, light exposure, source, and whether waking was reported or device-estimated.
constraints: Clock time and light exposure do not establish internal circadian phase.
Do not assume a conventional day schedule.

phases.description: A flexible label for a person's waking interval, which may vary with work, care, health, or chosen schedule.
phases.basisGuidance: Derive only from explicitly reported or measured wake intervals; retain gaps and uncertainty.
constraints: Does not imply alertness, productivity, or adequate sleep.
Do not treat daytime as the same clock hours for everyone.

phases.description: A reflective label for a chosen transition toward rest or a change in light and activity.
phases.basisGuidance: Person-defined or explicitly observed window with local time, light/activity source, and uncertainty.
constraints: Not a measured melatonin rise or biological night.
Do not assume a fixed bedtime or evening routine.

phases.description: An estimated internal circadian-night window only when a named method supports that estimate.
phases.basisGuidance: Name the measurement or estimation method, collection conditions, version, and uncertainty.
constraints: Do not infer from clock time or sleep onset alone.
Not a hormone assay or diagnosis.

phases.description: A reported eating event situated in the person's own daily and social context.
phases.basisGuidance: Person report or clearly identified source with time precision and optional meal context.
constraints: A logged meal does not establish all food intake.
Do not moralize foods, timing, appetite, or eating patterns.

phases.description: An interval between recorded eating events, named only when its bounds are supported by records.
phases.basisGuidance: Use explicit event timestamps and report coverage; mark unknown intake and missing data.
constraints: A gap in a log is not evidence of fasting.
Do not infer metabolic state or hormone levels from the interval.

phases.description: An explicitly reported fasting interval, whether chosen, medically directed, or shaped by circumstance.
phases.basisGuidance: Record the person's stated start/end, reason if they choose to share it, and relevant context.
constraints: Do not prescribe, praise, or recommend fasting.
Never apply adult fasting interpretations to infants or children.

phases.description: A person-reported or device-observed within-day alternation of activity and rest.
phases.basisGuidance: Name the signal and method, sampling interval, coverage, and uncertainty.
constraints: Do not equate a wearable pattern with a specific hormone pulse.
Do not infer attention, mood, or capacity without separate observations.

phases.description: A reported infant or caregiver feeding bout placed in its care context.
phases.basisGuidance: Identify reporter, feeding event/time, and source; preserve missingness and clinical context when supplied.
constraints: Do not impose a schedule or infer infant wellbeing from timing alone.
Do not apply adult meal-window or fasting models.
